title: permit_effects_exact
description: A successful permit(owner, spender, value, deadline, sig) sets allowance[owner][spender] = value, changes owner's nonce from n to n+1 (mod 2^256), and changes no other allowance, nonce, balance or totalSupply.

title: permit_rejects_expired_and_zero_owner
description: permit reverts when block.timestamp > deadline or owner is the zero address.

title: permit_requires_owner_signature
description: permit succeeds only if ecrecover over the EIP-712 digest returns owner for a 65-byte signature, or owner's isValidSignature(digest, sig) returns the EIP-1271 magic value.

title: nonces_change_only_by_permit
description: For every sDAI method other than permit, no nonce changes; permit changes only the nonce of its owner argument, so a consumed nonce is never re-issued (short of 2^256 permits).

title: domain_separator_bound_to_chain
description: DOMAIN_SEPARATOR() returns the cached separator on the deployment chain, and on any other chain id returns a different value, so signatures cannot be replayed across a fork.
